subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a public per-model total-generation deadline, and should its canonical owner be the agent model runtime entry with an optional global default?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding another timeout knob requires an intentional precedence and compatibility policy across run, provider-idle, compaction, and fallback budgets.

options.title: Add a model generation deadline
options.body: Add an optional non-resetting deadline to global agent defaults and per-model runtime entries, with unset values preserving current behavior and documented precedence over only the selected attempt.

options.title: Keep provider and run controls only
options.body: Reject the new config surface and continue using provider idle timeouts plus the global run timeout, accepting that actively streaming loops require separate safeguards.

options.title: Prioritize semantic loop detection
options.body: Address repetitive streaming through the narrower circuit-breaker work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44965 without introducing a wall-clock per-model deadline.

recommendation.title: Add a model generation deadline
recommendation.body: Add an optional non-resetting deadline to global agent defaults and per-model runtime entries, with unset values preserving current behavior and documented precedence over only the selected attempt.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the detailed contract review and has adjacent embedded-runner history, making this the strongest available owner for the product-level timeout precedence decision.
